major_cooldowns.name: Tiger's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it every 30 seconds with at least 50 energy missing (70 or more in AoE) to bank the free 50 energy, then reapply Rip, Rake and Moonfire inside the window so they snapshot the damage bonus.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base duration is 10s; Predator and Raging Fury extend it, and the sampled top parse shows 15s.

major_cooldowns.name: Berserk
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown with Tiger's Fury already active, then spend every combo point and Overflowing Power stack across the 15 second window so nothing is left when it expires.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cooldown is 180s; Berserk: Heart of the Lion cuts it to 120s, which is what the sampled top parse ran.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The Berserk upgrade: press it with Tiger's Fury up, and spend the free in-combat Prowl it grants on an empowered Rake.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cooldown 180s; Berserk: Heart of the Lion removes 60s and Ashamane's Guidance a further 30s. Not pressed in the sampled parse but a real castable ability.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it inside Berserk with Tiger's Fury still running, at 2 or fewer combo points and ideally straight after a Rip or Ferocious Bite; with Ashamane's Guidance hold to a strict 1 minute cycle so it never drifts off Berserk.

major_cooldowns.name: Feral Frenzy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast at 0 to 2 combo points (up to 4 inside Berserk) and follow it immediately with a finisher; with Focused Frenzy it lines up with every Tiger's Fury.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cooldown 45s; Focused Frenzy reduces it by 15s, which matches the 17 casts in the sampled top parse.

major_cooldowns.name: Frantic Frenzy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The AoE replacement for Feral Frenzy: cast it during Tiger's Fury on 2 or more targets, or at 0 to 2 combo points, lining it up with every third Tiger's Fury or holding it to land with Berserk.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Name-verified castable ability; not pressed in the sampled parse, which ran the Focused Frenzy half of the node.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it before the pull so the mastery buff lands with your first Tiger's Fury, then keep every later use glued to Berserk.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket, so zero casts is normal for anyone not carrying it.

rule.description: Rip up on the target at all times
rule.action: Hold Rip at 100% uptime. Refresh it at 5 combo points inside its 7.2 second pandemic window, ideally with Tiger's Fury active so the new one snapshots the buff.

Let Rip run down into its last 7.2 seconds before you refresh it. Overwrite it earlier only to re-snapshot under Tiger's Fury; otherwise wait, because a clipped Rip throws away duration you already paid 5 combo points for.

rule.description: Ferocious Bite only once Rip is ticking
rule.action: Only spend combo points on Ferocious Bite once Rip is applied, and leave enough Rip duration to rebuild 5 combo points before it expires.

rule.description: Ferocious Bite at 50 or more energy
rule.action: Pool to 50 energy before committing to Ferocious Bite so it consumes the full 25 extra energy and doubles its damage, and always send it at 5 combo points.
Press Tiger's Fury first, then Berserk inside it, and dump every combo point across the 15 second window.
Channel Convoke the Spirits inside Berserk with Tiger's Fury still up, at 2 or fewer combo points, and never let the two cooldowns drift apart.

rule.description: Feral Frenzy at low combo points
rule.action: Fire Feral Frenzy at 0 to 2 combo points, or up to 4 inside Berserk, then spend the 5 points it awards straight away.

rule.description: Apex Predator's Craving spent on Ferocious Bite
rule.action: Bite on sight when Apex Predator's Craving procs so the next one is not overwritten; it is free, but still try to have 50 energy for the full hit.

rule.description: Swipe over Shred on multiple targets
rule.action: From 2 targets on, build combo points with Swipe instead of Shred, and spend every Clearcasting proc on it.

rule.description: Opener: Tiger's Fury, Rake, Berserk, Rip
rule.action: Open from Prowl with Tiger's Fury into a stealthed Rake, go straight into Berserk, and land a 5 combo point Rip inside the window before continuing the priority.
